name: Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club Adult Tank Top
short_description:
Stay cool and comfortable while representing your club with the official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club Adult Tank Top. Whether you’re cheering from the deck, coaching, swimming, or enjoying a day by the pool, this lightweight tank is built for all-day comfort and classic summer style.

Featuring the official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club logo on the left chest and a full-color sponsor design across the back, this tank is perfect for swimmers, parents, coaches, lifeguards, volunteers, and club supporters.

Available in Black, Royal Blue, and White, this versatile tank is an ideal choice for practices, swim meets, tournaments, and everyday summer wear.

Features

  • Official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club apparel
  • Left chest club logo
  • Full-color sponsor artwork on the back
  • Soft, lightweight cotton blend construction
  • Comfortable unisex fit
  • Perfect for swim meets, pool days, workouts, and casual wear
  • Available in Black, Royal Blue, and White

name: Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club Performance Sun Hat
short_description:
Stay cool and protected while representing Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club with this premium embroidered performance sun hat. Designed for long days at the pool, swim meets, tennis matches, camps, and outdoor activities, this lightweight hat provides excellent sun protection without sacrificing comfort.

Featuring the official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club logo professionally embroidered on the front, this hat includes a wide brim, moisture-wicking performance fabric, adjustable chin cord, and a removable neck cape for additional protection from the sun.

Available in White, Navy, and Black, it’s the perfect accessory for swimmers, coaches, parents, lifeguards, and club supporters throughout the summer season.

Features

  • Premium performance sun hat
  • Official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club embroidered logo
  • Wide brim for maximum sun protection
  • Removable neck cape for added UV coverage
  • Lightweight, breathable performance fabric
  • Adjustable chin cord for a secure fit
  • Moisture-wicking construction
  • Ideal for swim meets, pool days, tennis, camps, and outdoor activities
  • Available in White, Navy, and Black

name: Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club Boat Tote Bag
short_description:
Carry everything you need for the pool, beach, or everyday errands with the official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club Boat Tote Bag. Available with your choice of a high-quality printed logo or premium embroidered logo, this durable tote combines timeless style with everyday functionality.

Featuring the official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club logo, this spacious canvas tote is perfect for swim practice, tennis matches, summer camps, grocery trips, vacations, and daily use. Heavy-duty construction and reinforced handles make it a dependable companion whether you’re heading to the pool or spending the day at the beach.

Choose the decoration style that best fits your preference:

  • Printed Logo – Crisp, vibrant detail with a smooth finish.
  • Embroidered Logo – Premium stitched appearance for a classic, textured look.

Features

  • Heavy-duty canvas boat tote
  • Official Walden Glen Swim & Racquet Club design
  • Available in printed or embroidered decoration
  • Large main compartment
  • Reinforced carrying handles
  • Front exterior pocket
  • Ideal for pool days, beach trips, tennis, shopping, and everyday use
  • Durable construction built for repeated use

name: Operation Kid You Not Curfew Crew Patch
short_description:
The Operation Kid You Not Curfew Crew Patch is a premium embroidered morale patch inspired by the overnight missions and long shifts of MPDC’s Civil Disturbance Unit (CDU). Featuring bold artwork and the phrase “Bedtime Was Hours Ago,” this collectible patch celebrates the dedication, humor, and resilience of law enforcement professionals working when the rest of the city is asleep. Perfect for collectors, officers, and supporters of the first responder community.

***Pre-Order***Shipping will begin on or before 7/24/26
